No conflicts of interest exist with respect to authorship, publication, or interpretation of the content presented.

detail.abstract:
Background: Contemporary pharmaceutical regulation confronts a governance challenge that existing institutional architectures were not designed to address: the continuous and dynamic evolution of evidentiary profiles across the full therapeutic lifecycle of authorized products. Real-world evidence (RWE), accelerated authorization pathways, and post-market evidence generation have each expanded substantially, yet regulatory systems remain organized around episodic authorization decisions, fragmented post-market surveillance mechanisms, and static evidentiary assumptions that no longer reflect the evidence environment pharmaceutical governance must manage.

Objective: This paper develops an integrated conceptual governance framework for adaptive lifecycle regulation capable of continuously managing evidentiary uncertainty throughout the therapeutic product lifecycle, and proposes a transition pathway from authorization-centered governance toward continuous performance-centered evidentiary stewardship.

Approach: Drawing on scholarship in real-world evidence methodology, adaptive licensing, lifecycle regulation, pharmacoepidemiology, AI-enabled regulatory systems, and regulatory ethics, the paper conducts a critical analytical review of current evidentiary governance limitations and develops a conceptual governance architecture for continuous evidentiary stewardship across the full pharmaceutical product lifecycle.

Contributions: The paper introduces Regulatory Evidence Debt and Evidence Liquidity as foundational diagnostic concepts and develops the Dynamic Adaptive Regulatory Evidence Model (DAREM), a six-stage governance framework supported by the Dynamic Evidence Reliability Index (DERI), Living Regulatory Authorization, AI-Regulator Co-Governance, and Regulatory Digital Twins. The framework further reconceptualizes RWE as ethical infrastructure and proposes Performance-Based Regulation and Living Drug Approval as future models for adaptive lifecycle governance.

Policy Relevance: The framework is operationalized through ethical governance principles, AI-assisted evidence synthesis mechanisms, and phased regulatory implementation pathways designed to support practical adoption across regulatory jurisdictions.

Conclusions: The future of pharmaceutical regulation may depend less on accelerating authorization decisions and more on developing the institutional capacities, evidence infrastructure, ethical safeguards, and international cooperation required for continuous evidentiary governance. DAREM provides one possible architecture for this transition, reimagining pharmaceutical regulation as a continuously adaptive system of evidentiary stewardship rather than a sequence of episodic authorization decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态适应性监管证据模型（DAREM），旨在将药品监管从以授权为中心的静态模式，转型为覆盖产品全生命周期的连续证据治理体系，并引入"监管证据债务"和"证据流动性"等核心概念。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够持续管理治疗产品全生命周期中证据不确定性的整合性概念治理框架？
AI.motivation: 现有药品监管体系围绕阶段性授权决策组织，碎片化的上市后监测机制和静态的证据假设已无法应对真实世界证据（RWE）、加速审批路径和上市后证据生成带来的持续动态证据挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态适应性监管证据模型（DAREM），包括动态证据可靠性指数（DERI）、活态监管授权、AI-监管者共治、监管数字孪生等核心组件。
AI.method: 基于真实世界证据方法论、适应性许可、生命周期监管、药物流行病学、AI赋能监管系统及监管伦理学等学术领域，进行批判性分析综述并发展概念性治理架构。
AI.findings: 提出了"监管证据债务"和"证据流动性"作为诊断性概念，构建了六阶段DAREM治理框架，将真实世界证据重新概念化为道德基础设施，并提出了基于绩效的监管和活态药品批准等未来模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入"监管证据债务"与"证据流动性"两个原创概念性工具，提出了将RWE从数据来源重新定义为道德基础设施的理论转向，构建了从授权中心治理向连续证据管理的范式转换框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的伦理治理原则、AI辅助证据合成机制及分阶段监管实施路径，支持不同监管辖区的实际采纳与落地。

title: Debating The Eu-Mercosur Agreement About To Enter Into Force: A Case Study On Strategic Decision-Making Under Uncertainty - Case Description Part
affiliations: and

detail.title: Debating The Eu-Mercosur Agreement About To Enter Into Force: A Case Study On Strategic Decision-Making Under Uncertainty - Case Description Part

keywords: Criteria for Decision-Making under Risk and Uncertainty

contentType.other: Working Paper in a very advanced stage

detail.abstract: A heterogeneous group of businesspeople, who have a wide range of interests and expectations and must make decisions under uncertainty and unpredictable circumstances, are the main characters in this case study. They share a dilemma at a specific point in time related to the EU-Mercosur Agreement and how it may evolve. On the other hand, the bicentennial "Chamber of Commerce Rio de Janeiro" ("Associação Comercial do Rio de Janeiro", ACRJ) faces the ongoing institutional challenge of increasing and maintaining its membership while providing its members with access to practical and timely information. The aim of this case study is to provoke reflection and discussion on how a major geopolitical development may affect business perceptions, managerial understanding, and decision-making rather than informing about the legal or negotiation details of the EU-Mercosur Agreement. The case description, based on real facts and debates, along with teaching notes (in a separate document), provides material and questions for using this case study in a wide range of courses or events for participants with varying levels of prior education and diverse backgrounds, but with common interest in international affairs, agreements, trade, investments, and business.

AI.tldr: 本文以欧盟-南方共同市场协定为背景，通过里约热内卢商会案例，探讨重大地缘政治事件如何影响商业感知、管理理解和决策制定，旨在引发反思与讨论，而非提供法律或谈判细节。
AI.research_question: 重大地缘政治发展（如欧盟-南方共同市场协定）如何影响商业人士的感知、管理理解和决策制定？
AI.motivation: 帮助多元化背景的商业人士（需在不确定和不可预测环境下做决策）理解地缘政治事件对其商业判断的影响，同时为拥有两百年历史的里约热内卢商会提供维持会员增长和提供及时信息的机构挑战的思考框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 案例教学法；地缘政治与商业决策的交叉视角；感知与决策理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，基于真实事实和辩论，提供案例描述与配套教学笔记（单独文件）。
AI.findings: 本文不提供实证发现，而是提供教学材料以激发关于地缘政治事件如何塑造商业认知与决策的课堂讨论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘政治分析引入商业管理教育，强调地缘政治事件对商业感知和决策的影响机制，而非仅关注法律或谈判技术细节。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同教育背景和经验的学员提供讨论素材，适用于国际事务、贸易、投资、商业等课程；帮助商会等机构思考如何在不确定性中为会员提供有价值的信息服务。

title: The Logic Structure Behind Mathematical Models: An Axiomatic Framework for System Dynamics
affiliations: Zhejiang University

detail.title: The Logic Structure Behind Mathematical Models: An Axiomatic Framework for System Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Natural Science Foundation of Zhejiang Province (LZ24E080002), which is gratefully acknowledged.

detail.abstract: Modeling complex systems typically involves multiscale analysis, multiphysics coupling, and cross-domain integration. However, existing methodologies predominantly focus on constructing and solving specific equations, lacking a unified, explicit expression for underlying logical structures, which limits model comparison and combination. To address this issue, this paper proposes Axiomatic System Dynamics (ASD), a formal modeling language that decouples a model's logical structure from its mathematical form by formalizing a mathematical model as a combination of a conceptual model and its mathematical realization. Grounded in primitive concepts-state, action, and parameter-ASD introduces generalized constitutive relationships to formulate a unified representation of system evolution. On this basis, a modular "conceptual model first, mathematical model second" paradigm is established to explicitly characterize causal relationships and identify logical isomorphisms across varied mathematical models. Through case studies spanning Newtonian mechanics, ideal gases, material constitutive relationships, and soil consolidation theory, we demonstrate that classical cross-domain theories can be formalized as specific implementations of their respective underlying system dynamics "mother structure." Ultimately, ASD provides a meta-modeling framework independent of concrete mathematical forms, establishing a methodological foundation for logical expression, model comparison, and the meso-level deductive synthesis of cross-domain theories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出公理系统动力学（ASD），一种将模型逻辑结构与数学形式解耦的形式化建模语言，通过"概念模型优先、数学模型其次"的模块化范式，为跨领域理论的逻辑表达、模型比较和中介演绎综合提供方法论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一种能够统一表达复杂系统底层逻辑结构、独立于具体数学形式的形式化建模语言，以克服现有方法在模型比较与组合方面的局限？
AI.motivation: 现有建模方法主要聚焦于特定方程组的构建与求解，缺乏对底层逻辑结构的统一显式表达，限制了跨领域模型的比较与组合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公理系统动力学（ASD），基于状态、行为、参数三个原始概念，引入广义本构关系，将数学模型形式化为概念模型与其数学实现的组合。
AI.method: 通过案例研究，展示牛顿力学、理想气体、材料本构关系和土体固结理论等经典跨领域理论可被形式化为各自底层系统动力学"母结构"的具体实现。
AI.findings: 跨领域经典理论可被形式化为底层系统动力学"母结构"的具体实现，ASD提供了独立于具体数学形式的元建模框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出ASD作为元建模框架，实现逻辑结构与数学形式的解耦，识别跨领域模型间的逻辑同构性，建立"概念模型优先、数学模型其次"的模块化范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂系统的逻辑表达、跨领域模型比较以及中介层面的演绎综合提供方法论基础，有助于跨学科模型的重用与整合。

title: Who Bears the Burden of Digital Services Taxes?
affiliations: , Tilburg School of Economics and Management, Tilburg University and

detail.title: Who Bears the Burden of Digital Services Taxes?
detail.abstract: Several European countries have introduced Digital Services Taxes (DSTs) on domestic advertising revenues of large digital platforms such as Google, aiming to increase tax revenues from these platforms. This paper examines whether the burden of these taxes is borne by platforms (as intended by governments) or passed on to advertisers through higher advertising prices. Using a novel advertiser-level panel dataset on Google Ads spending, prices, and clicks across 29 European countries from 2018 to 2022, and exploiting the staggered introduction of tax surcharges on advertisers' invoices in a di!erence-in-di!erences framework, we find that advertisers bear a substantial share of the tax burden. Following the introduction of the surcharge, e!ective costs per click increased by approximately 3.4% within six months, consistent with near-complete pass-through of the tax. These results indicate that, while DSTs generate considerable tax revenues, their incidence falls largely on domestic advertisers rather than on digital platforms. Additional evidence on the mechanisms suggests that advertisers largely maintain their tax-exclusive ad budgets and receive a similar number of clicks as before the reform, implying higher e!ective prices per click after the surcharge. This pattern is consistent with advertisers' underreaction to surcharges that are added ex post to monthly invoices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧洲数字服务税（DST）的实际负担归宿，发现税收负担并未由大型数字平台承担，而是通过提高广告价格几乎完全转嫁给了国内广告商。
AI.research_question: 数字服务税（DST）的税收负担是由平台承担，还是通过提高广告价格转嫁给广告商？
AI.motivation: 多个欧洲国家推出了针对大型数字平台（如Google）国内广告收入的数字服务税，旨在增加税收。但税收的实际经济归宿（谁真正承担了税负）并不明确，政策效果需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收归宿理论；不完全竞争市场下的税负转嫁理论；消费者（此处为广告商）对附加费用的行为反应（underreaction to surcharges）。
AI.method: 利用2018-2022年29个欧洲国家的广告商层面面板数据（Google Ads支出、价格、点击量），采用交错双重差分法（staggered DiD），利用各国引入发票上税收附加费的时间差异进行识别。
AI.findings: 1. 税收附加费引入后，有效每次点击成本（e!ective cost per click）在6个月内上升约3.4%，接近于税收的完全转嫁。2. 广告商维持了不含税的广告预算，获得的点击量基本不变，说明他们承担了更高的有效价格。3. 这一模式与广告商对月结发票上附加费用的反应不足（underreaction）相一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字服务税的税收归宿提供了首个广告商层面的微观实证证据；揭示了在平台市场背景下，税收可能通过"附加费"形式转嫁的机制，丰富了税收归宿理论和消费者行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者具有重要启示：数字服务税虽然能产生可观的税收收入，但其实际负担主要落在国内广告商（而非大型科技平台）身上，与政策设计的初衷存在偏差。这提示政策设计需更关注税收归宿的实际效果。

title: How Emerging-Market SMEs Build AI Capability: Adoption Patterns, Intermediaries, and Absorptive Capacity in Southeast Asia

detail.title: How Emerging-Market SMEs Build AI Capability: Adoption Patterns, Intermediaries, and Absorptive Capacity in Southeast Asia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of a firm that provides AI development and implementation services to SMEs in Thailand. This practitioner role is disclosed in the paper and is the source of the anonymised illustration in Section 4. The paper is conceptual; no client data, commercial relationships, or identifiable firms are reported, and no organisation other than the author influenced the content. The author declares no other competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual paper with no human participants and no collection of personal data. The brief illustration in Section 4 is anonymised practitioner observation, not study data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Small and medium enterprises in emerging economies are adopting artificial intelligence rapidly but unevenly, and the existing literature explains the unevenness poorly. Industry evidence indicates that nearly half of firms now abandon most of the AI initiatives they begin, yet adoption research remains dominated by variance models that identify which factors predict adoption while saying little about how capability actually develops inside a firm over time, why some tools take hold while others are abandoned, and what part external specialists play in the process. This paper argues that AI capability in emerging-market SMEs is best understood as a developmental process shaped by three interacting forces: the informal, often unsanctioned use of AI tools by employees and, distinctively in SMEs, by founders themselves; the firm's absorptive capacity for new technology; and the intervention of commercial AI service firms that build and deploy systems on the firm's behalf. It positions absorptive capacity as the connective construct, reframes commercial AI service firms as a distinct and under-theorised type of innovation intermediary, shows why emerging-market conditions amplify each force, and sets out testable propositions and a research agenda for studying what works, what fails, and why, in the Southeast Asian SME context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出新兴经济体中小企业的AI能力发展是一个由三股力量相互作用的动态过程：员工和创始人的非正式AI使用、企业的吸收能力、以及商业AI服务公司的介入。研究将吸收能力定位为联结性构念，将商业AI服务公司重新定义为一种创新中介，并提出了可检验的研究命题。
AI.research_question: 新兴经济体中小企业如何发展AI能力？为什么有的AI工具被采纳而有的被放弃？外部专业机构在这一过程中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有采用研究以方差模型为主，只关注哪些因素预测采纳，却很少解释能力如何在企业内部随时间发展、为什么一些工具被采纳而另一些被放弃、以及外部专家在过程中扮演什么角色。近半数中小企业放弃了大部分已启动的AI项目，这一现象亟需理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三种相互作用的力量：1) 员工和创始人的非正式、未经批准的AI使用；2) 企业对新技术吸收能力；3) 商业AI服务公司的干预。吸收能力被定位为联结性构念，商业AI服务公司被重新概念化为一种独特的创新中介。
AI.method: 理论构建与命题推导，基于对东南亚中小企业情境的分析，提出可检验的研究命题和研究议程。
AI.findings: 1) 非正式AI使用（尤其是创始人本人）是中小企业AI能力发展的重要但被忽视的起点；2) 吸收能力是连接非正式使用和外部服务商干预的关键构念；3) 新兴经济体条件（制度环境脆弱、资源约束、人才短缺等）会放大上述三种力量；4) 商业AI服务公司作为创新中介的理论角色需要重新认识。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将AI采用研究从方差模型转向过程视角；2) 首次将商业AI服务公司理论化为一种独特的创新中介类型；3) 将吸收能力理论扩展到新兴经济体中小企业AI情境；4) 整合非正式使用、吸收能力和外部中介三股力量，形成一个系统的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体中小企业管理者理解和管理AI能力发展提供过程性指导，减少AI项目的盲目启动和随意放弃；为政策制定者支持中小企业AI转型提供理论依据。

detail.abstract:
This paper advances The Jurisdictional Signal Formatting Doctrine, a constitutional-systems and media-architecture framework explaining how public meaning is selected, routed, compressed, accelerated, personalized, amplified, corrected, and fragmented before it reaches citizens, representatives, courts, agencies, markets, and executive decision-makers. The doctrine argues that modern media systems do not merely distribute information; they format civic reality by transforming public events into jurisdiction-specific civic objects shaped by editorial judgment, commercial incentives, platform architecture, algorithmic routing, audience segmentation, social reinforcement, creator interpretation, and artificial-intelligence summarization.

The paper defines Jurisdictional Signal Integrity Collapse as the condition in which civic signal loses traceability, jurisdictional context, proportionality, correction capacity, temporal discipline, or shared-object recognizability as it moves from public occurrence into civic and institutional reception. The result is not the absence of speech, but the overproduction of formatted signal environments in which citizens may speak freely while increasingly failing to recognize the same civic object under dispute.

Using the 1960s American broadcast environment and the 2026 platform environment as comparative baselines, the paper distinguishes scarcity-based broadcast architecture from abundance-based algorithmic architecture. The earlier environment carried risks of concentrated gatekeeping and exclusion, while the contemporary environment expands participation, pluralism, and access but increases acceleration, personalization, fragmentation, and jurisdictional non-recognition. The comparison is not nostalgic; it is architectural.

The doctrine contributes to constitutional analysis by distinguishing protected expression from governance-ready signal. The First Amendment protects speech, press, dissent, criticism, advocacy, error, and disagreement, but lawful public signal must still pass through jurisdiction, representation, deliberation, procedure, evidence, statutory authority, and institutional judgment before it may become binding governmental action. Accordingly, the paper does not propose censorship, viewpoint restriction, state licensing of journalism, compelled interpretation, judicial supervision of public meaning, or a new cause of action. Instead, it offers a diagnostic vocabulary for understanding how media architecture affects public comprehension, institutional legitimacy, and constitutional processability.

The paper concludes that the proper response to signal collapse is not interpretive control, but structural resilience: source traceability, civic education, media literacy, procedural literacy, correction visibility, local-news capacity, platform transparency, artificial-intelligence disclosure, public-interest journalism, institutional communication discipline, and archival preservation. The doctrine’s aim is to preserve the conditions under which free speech remains intelligible, disagreement remains governable, journalism remains independent, and constitutional self-government remains capable of translating public meaning into lawful institutional action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"管辖权信号格式化原则"，分析现代媒体系统如何将公共事件格式化为特定的公民认知对象，并诊断"管辖权信号完整性崩溃"现象——即公民信号在传播过程中失去可追溯性、管辖权语境和共享对象可识别性。论文比较了1960年代稀缺型广播环境与2026年丰裕型算法环境，指出当代挑战不在于言论缺失，而在于信号过载与碎片化导致公民无法识别共同的争议对象。解决方案不是审查或管控，而是结构性韧性建设。
AI.research_question: 现代媒体架构如何影响公共信号从公共事件到公民和制度接收者的传播过程？"管辖权信号完整性崩溃"如何发生及其对宪政自我治理的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有宪法分析未能充分解释媒体系统架构变化如何影响公共意义的形成与制度接收。在算法驱动、平台主导的媒体环境中，公民虽然享有言论自由，却越来越难以识别和讨论同一个公共争议对象，这对民主治理和法治构成根本性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管辖权信号格式化原则（Jurisdictional Signal Formatting Doctrine）；管辖权信号完整性崩溃（Jurisdictional Signal Integrity Collapse）；稀缺型广播架构与丰裕型算法架构的比较框架；信号与言论的区分（受保护的表达与可治理的信号）。
AI.method: 比较历史分析：以1960年代美国广播环境和2026年平台环境为基线，进行架构性对比，而非怀旧性评价。通过制度分析、媒体架构分析、宪法理论分析相结合的方法展开论证。
AI.findings: 1) 现代媒体系统不是简单分发信息，而是通过编辑判断、商业激励、平台架构、算法路由、受众分割、社会强化、创作者解读和AI摘要等机制格式化公民现实。2) 当代丰裕型算法环境虽扩大了参与和多元性，但加剧了信号加速化、个性化、碎片化和管辖权非识别问题。3) 第一修正案保护表达自由，但合法公共信号仍需通过管辖权、代表、审议、程序、证据、法定权限和制度判断才能转为政府行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"管辖权信号格式化原则"这一新宪法分析与媒体架构框架；提出"管辖权信号完整性崩溃"这一诊断性概念；区分了"受保护的表达"与"可治理的信号"，为宪法分析提供新分析维度；建立了从媒体架构角度理解公共意义形成与制度合法性的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 不主张审查或管制，而是提供结构性韧性解决方案：源可追溯性、公民教育、媒体素养、程序素养、更正可见性、地方新闻能力、平台透明度、AI披露、公共利益新闻、制度传播纪律和档案保存。为立法者、法官、平台运营者和公民提供诊断媒体环境健康的概念工具。

title: AI-Augmented Patent Drafting at Scale: Empirical Evidence from a 96-Day Solo Filing Experiment
affiliations: Independent Inventor

detail.title: AI-Augmented Patent Drafting at Scale: Empirical Evidence from a 96-Day Solo Filing Experiment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses public administrative records (Canadian Intellectual Property Office filings) and the author's own filing history; no human or animal subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All filing fees and compute (LLM subscription) costs were personally funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Large language models are widely expected to lower the cost of patent drafting, but empirical evidence from real-world, at-scale deployments is scarce. We report a documented field case in which a single inventor filed 75 patent applications with one office (the Canadian Intellectual Property Office) over 96 days using a two-model LLM pipeline refined across seven versions. Using the complete filing record, including 37 dated office documents, we quantify cadence, per-application time, cost, and first-pass formal conformity. We find a measurable process learning curve (roughly four hours to about 2 h 20 per application), a highly bursty rather than linear cadence (75 filings on 21 distinct days, averaging 3.57 per active day), and a marginal direct cost approaching the statutory fee. Reading the office record correctly requires separating two phenomena: only 8% of applications drew an office non-compliance notice on the application itself, while a distinct 27% underwent a self-inflicted applicant-name correction. Measured filing-to-notice lags (median 13.5 days) show that formalities examination is fast enough that right-censoring does not materially bias the conformity estimate. We argue the central finding is structural: automating drafting shifts the binding constraint from authoring to filing and administration, and introduces a correlated failure mode in which one setup error propagates across a portfolio. We document the pipeline for reproducibility and discuss the study's limitations, including its single-experimenter design and the absence of grant-based quality validation.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个真实案例：一位发明者利用双模型LLM流水线在96天内向加拿大知识产权局提交了75项专利申请，量化了学习曲线、成本、节奏和合规性，发现自动化起草将瓶颈从撰写转移到了行政提交环节，并引入了一种相关故障模式。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型能否在实际大规模部署中降低专利起草成本？自动化专利起草的真实效率、成本和合规性如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM被广泛预期能降低专利起草成本，但缺乏来自真实世界大规模部署的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自动化起草对流程瓶颈的转移理论（从撰写到行政提交）；相关故障模式理论（一个设置错误传播至整个投资组合）。
AI.method: 单一发明者使用双模型LLM流水线（经过七个版本迭代）在96天内提交75项专利申请的实地案例研究，基于完整的申请记录（包括37份日期文件）进行定量分析。
AI.findings: (1) 存在可测量的学习曲线（从约4小时降至约2小时20分/件）；(2) 提交节奏呈高度爆发式而非线性（75件分布在21个活跃日，日均3.57件）；(3) 边际直接成本接近法定费用；(4) 仅8%申请收到办公室不合规通知，但另有27%出现申请人姓名自致错误；(5) 从提交到通知的中位滞后为13.5天；(6) 自动化起草将瓶颈从撰写转移到提交与行政管理，并引入相关故障模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了自动化专利起草中瓶颈转移的结构性变化，以及相关故障模式这一新现象，为数字劳动分工中的流程瓶颈理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM在专利起草领域的实际部署提供了效率、成本和合规性的量化证据；展示了可复现的LLM流水线；提醒实践者注意自动化后行政环节的新瓶颈和系统性错误风险。

title: The Corporate Legal Service Maturity Model (CLS-MM)
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Corporate Legal Service Maturity Model (CLS-MM)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical approval was required for this study, as it does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced this work.

detail.abstract:
Corporate legal departments face a structural dilemma: their most valuable contributions are preventive and counterfactual, yet existing reporting systems are not designed to capture absence as value. While external legal services appear as measurable expenses, internal legal functions are evaluated under the same cost-based logic, creating a persistent gap between legal impact and its observable representation.

Existing maturity frameworks, such as those developed by ACC and CLOC, have focused primarily on internal legal operations, offering structured approaches to process optimization, technology adoption, and cost control. However, they provide limited explanatory power in contexts characterized by high regulatory complexity, constrained resources, and asymmetric workload distribution, particularly in emerging market environments.

This paper introduces the Corporate Legal Service Maturity Model (CLS-MM), a design science framework that reconceptualizes legal maturity as a property of legal service delivery across the organization, rather than of legal operations alone. The model proposes four maturity stages and eight diagnostic dimensions, complemented by ten diagnostic metrics, including three novel indicators designed to capture resource–complexity asymmetries. By shifting the analytical focus toward the legal–business interface, the CLS-MM offers a diagnostic and prescriptive tool for assessing legal effectiveness in complex organizational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了企业法律服务成熟度模型（CLS-MM），通过设计科学研究方法，将法律成熟度重新定义为组织层面法律服务交付的属性，而非仅法律运营的属性。该模型包含四个成熟阶段、八个诊断维度及十项诊断指标（含三项新型指标），旨在评估复杂组织环境中的法律有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限、监管复杂和 workload 分布不对称的新兴市场环境中，系统性地评估和提升企业法律部门的服务交付成熟度？
AI.motivation: 企业法务部门面临结构性困境：其最有价值的贡献是预防性和反事实的（防止问题发生），但现有报告系统无法将"缺失"（absence）捕捉为价值。外部法律服务被视为可衡量的费用，而内部法务职能却用同样的成本逻辑评估，造成法律影响与实际表现之间的持续鸿沟。现有成熟度框架（如ACC和CLOC）主要关注内部法律运营，在监管复杂性高、资源受限、工作量分布不对称的新兴市场环境中解释力有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学（Design Science）；企业法律服务成熟度模型（CLS-MM）；法律成熟度作为组织层面法律服务交付的属性，而非仅法律运营的属性。
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法。模型构建包括四个成熟阶段、八个诊断维度、十项诊断指标（含三项新型指标，用于捕捉资源-复杂性不对称）。
AI.findings: 提出了CLS-MM模型，该模型将分析焦点转向法律-业务界面上，为复杂组织环境中评估法律有效性提供了诊断性和规定性工具。模型包含三项新型指标以捕捉资源-复杂性不对称，弥补了现有框架的不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律成熟度从"法律运营属性"重新概念化为"组织层面法律服务交付属性"，为理解法务部门价值创造提供了新的理论视角。通过设计科学研究范式，构建了更具解释力的诊断框架。
AI.practical_contributions: CLS-MM为企业法务部门提供了诊断性和规定性工具，帮助其在复杂组织环境中评估法律有效性；新型指标可捕捉资源-复杂性不对称，有助于新兴市场环境中企业识别和弥补法务管理短板。

title: When Better AI Hurts: Verification, Compliance, and AI-Human Handoffs in Service Systems
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School, University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management, University of Rochester - Simon Business School and University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management

detail.title: When Better AI Hurts: Verification, Compliance, and AI-Human Handoffs in Service Systems
detail.abstract: Generative AI agents deployed in customer-facing services introduce a distinctive failure mode: hallucination risk, whereby AI responses appear plausible and complete yet may be incorrect, with correctness unobservable prior to human verification. We develop a game-theoretic queueing model of AI-human handoffs in which a firm sets a verification policy and strategic, delay-sensitive customers decide whether to bypass human review and exit with unverified AI answers. Our central finding is an AI improvement trap: when hallucination risk exceeds a critical threshold, improving AI accuracy can paradoxically reduce the effective throughput, which is the rate of successful service completions. The mechanism operates through equilibrium responses: more reliable AI makes customers more willing to forgo human verification, compelling the firm to change its verification policy to maintain compliance. This equilibrium adjustment expands unverified completions, and the resulting errors can outweigh the direct accuracy gains. Consumer surplus, however, always increases with AI accuracy, revealing a firm-customer incentive misalignment: firms may rationally resist AI investments that benefit customers. We further extend the model to incorporate several distinctive features of GenAI systems, including AI reasoning, feedback learning, and imperfect difficulty assessment. These extensions reveal that enhancing AI capability does not automatically improve operational performance. Instead, the benefits of better AI depend critically on how improvements reshape customer behavior and firm policies, reinforcing the central role of strategic responses in determining system outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式AI在客户服务中可能产生的"幻觉风险"，发现当幻觉风险超过临界阈值时，提升AI准确率反而会降低有效服务吞吐量，形成"AI改进陷阱"。
AI.research_question: 在存在幻觉风险的AI客服场景中，AI准确率的提升如何影响系统的有效服务吞吐量？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在客服领域被大量部署，但其可能产生看似合理实则错误的回答（幻觉风险），这种独特的故障模式如何影响企业运营和客户行为尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论排队模型（Game-theoretic queueing model），其中企业设定验证策略，具有时间敏感性的策略客户决定是否跳过人工审核直接采纳AI回答。
AI.method: 博弈论建模与均衡分析，并扩展模型纳入AI推理、反馈学习和不完美难度评估等特征。
AI.findings: 存在"AI改进陷阱"：当幻觉风险超过临界阈值时，提升AI准确率会通过改变客户行为和企业验证策略，导致未验证完成量增加，错误累积抵消直接准确率提升，反而降低有效吞吐量。但消费者剩余始终随AI准确率上升，存在企业与客户激励错位。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示AI客服场景中"AI改进陷阱"这一反直觉现象，建立了AI准确率、客户策略行为和企业验证策略之间的均衡理论，拓展了排队博弈理论在AI运营管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业AI客服部署提供重要警示：盲目提升AI准确率可能适得其反，需要统筹考虑客户行为变化和验证策略调整；揭示了企业理性地抵制有利于客户的AI投资的可能性。

title: A Policy Design Framework for Effective Ethical Governance of Artificial Intelligence in Defence
affiliations: , Oxford internet Institute and University of Oxford - Oxford Internet Institute

detail.title: A Policy Design Framework for Effective Ethical Governance of Artificial Intelligence in Defence

declarations.funderStatement: Antonia-Felicia Toffert, Cyril Birks, and Mariarosaria Taddeo have been funded by the Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl). The research underpinning this work was funded by the UK Defence Chief Scientific Advisor’s Science and Technology Portfolio, through the Dstl Autonomy Programme

detail.abstract: Ethical governance of artificial intelligence (AI) in defence must be legitimate under democratic standards and effective under operational pressure. The values it should serve are largely settled, as reflected in Just War Theory, International Humanitarian Law, and a convergent body of AI ethics. What is missing are the procedures to bind those principles to authoritative decision, institutional responsibility, and operational constraint. The deficit is therefore procedural, not substantive. In this article, we focus on ethical governance as a problem of policy design. Any such design must address three non-substitutable problems, those of knowledge, of authority and accountability, and of justification, each dominant at a different stage of the policy process: knowledge at inception, justification at deliberation, authority and accountability at operationalisation. We argue that defence does not create new problems but intensifies these, through recurring conditions such as operational tempo, secrecy, and coalition fragmentation that raise their difficulty without altering their kind. From this we build a stage-differentiated framework anchored by three instruments, a Non-Delegable Normative Decisions Register that records the substantive limits no procedure may override, diagonal-tiered transparency and accountability structures that allocate authority and extend scrutiny beyond the chain of command, and an Operational Requirements and Constraints Specification that converts those commitments into auditable parameters. The framework secures legitimacy through compliance with its procedures and makes its effectiveness assessable, so failures of either kind become visible and answerable.

AI.tldr: 本文认为国防领域AI伦理治理的赤字是程序性的而非实质性的，并提出了一个三阶段分框架来解决知识、权威与问责、以及正当化三个不可替代的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计国防领域人工智能伦理治理的程序性框架，使其既能满足民主标准的合法性，又能承受作战压力的有效性？
AI.motivation: 国防AI伦理治理的价值观已基本达成共识（如正义战争理论、国际人道法、AI伦理），但缺乏将原则与权威决策、制度责任和作战约束绑定起来的程序机制，这一程序性赤字亟待填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策设计理论、正义战争理论、国际人道法、AI伦理原则、治理程序理论
AI.method: 概念分析与框架构建：识别国防AI治理的三个非替代性问题（知识、权威与问责、正当化），对应政策过程的不同阶段，并据此设计三阶段差异化框架。
AI.findings: 国防并未创造新的治理问题，而是通过作战节奏、保密性和联盟碎片化等条件加剧了既有问题。提出的三阶段框架包括：(1)不可委托规范性决策登记册（Non-Delegable Normative Decisions Register）；(2)对角线分层透明与问责结构；(3)作战需求与约束规范说明书。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI伦理治理的焦点从实质性原则转向程序性设计，揭示了国防领域治理问题的非替代性特征，并建立了阶段差异化的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国防AI治理提供了可直接操作的三项制度工具，使合法性和有效性都可被评估和问责。

title: When the Scaffold Stays On: AI, Practice Style, and Screening in Elite Skill Formation

detail.title: When the Scaffold Stays On: AI, Practice Style, and Screening in Elite Skill Formation
detail.abstract: Generative AI raises short-term productivity by completing tasks that learners would otherwise practice on their own. Whether this substitution erodes frontier skill, the skill required for top-tail non-AI-aided performance, is an open question with growing stakes wherever AI is unavailable or insufficient. The sharper question, however, is whether selection mechanisms can screen apart two coexisting types: substitute-users, who use AI in place of deliberate practice, and complement-users, who use it to accelerate skill development. We exploit a feature of elite programming. The International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) and the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) prohibit AI under in-person proctoring and admit entrants through qualification rounds, whereas online Codeforces (CF) contests are unproctored and open to all. From CF submission histories we build an AI-prompt signature, marked by more first-attempt acceptances and fewer attempts and debugging retries, consistent with AI-assisted practice. Three patterns triangulate an institutional-screening mechanism. First, CF practice has shifted toward this signature across entry cohorts spanning two AI rollouts. Second, in open CF contests a stronger signature predicts smaller CF rating gains for users with no ICPC or IOI affiliation, but not for users who qualified for those AI-prohibited contests. Third, inside the AI-prohibited ICPC environment, a shift toward this AI-style practice predicts higher non-AI-aided scores for AI-era entrants. The same practice input thus carries opposite signs depending on whether the contest environment screens for it. The contrast points to two levers: how AI is integrated into training, since within the screened pool AI-style practice coincides with stronger non-AI-aided performance; and the design of AI-prohibited evaluation gates as a type-separating institution. Both extend beyond competitive programming to credentialing systems, from medical and legal boards to professional certification, that must certify skill in a workforce whose practice is increasingly shaped by AI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式AI对学习者技能的替代与补充效应，发现AI使用可分为替代型（替代刻意练习）和互补型（加速技能发展）。通过编程竞赛数据（ICPC/IOI禁止AI，Codeforces允许AI）构建AI提示特征，发现同一AI练习行为在筛选环境（禁止AI的竞赛）中预测更高非AI辅助成绩，而在开放环境中预测更低成绩，表明筛选机制可作为区分两种用户类型的制度设计。
AI.research_question: AI辅助学习是否会侵蚀学习者的前沿技能（即无需AI辅助时的顶尖表现）？以及是否存在筛选机制能够区分替代型用户（用AI替代刻意练习）和互补型用户（用AI加速技能发展）？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI通过替学习者完成任务来提高短期生产力，但这种替代是否会损害学习者独立完成任务所需的前沿技能尚不确定。尤其在AI不可用或不充分的场景中，这一问题的后果日益严重。现有研究缺乏区分不同AI使用模式及其长期影响的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代型vs互补型AI使用理论；技能发展的刻意练习理论；制度筛选机制理论。
AI.method: 利用国际大学生程序设计竞赛（ICPC）和国际信息学奥林匹克（IOI）禁止AI但有资格选拔赛，而在线Codeforces（CF）比赛不监考且对所有人开放的自然实验。从CF提交历史构建AI提示特征（首次接受率更高、尝试和调试次数更少），通过三个模式三角验证制度筛选机制：1) CF练习向AI提示特征迁移；2) AI提示特征在开放CF比赛中预测非ICPC/IOI选手更低评分增益，但不预测有竞赛资格选手；3) 在禁止AI的ICPC环境中，AI风格练习预测AI时代选手更高的非AI辅助成绩。
AI.findings: 1. CF练习模式随AI推出向AI提示特征迁移；2. 在开放比赛中，更强的AI提示特征预测非精英选手更小的CF评分增长，但对已进入禁止AI竞赛的选手无此负面效应；3. 在禁止AI的ICPC环境中，AI风格练习反而预测更高的非AI辅助成绩。同一练习行为在不同筛选环境中呈现相反预测方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了制度筛选机制可作为区分替代型与互补型AI用户的工具，丰富了AI使用效应异质性的理论解释，揭示了实践行为的意义依赖于环境筛选的存在与否。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI时代的教育评估和职业认证体系（医学、法律、专业资格认证等）提供重要启示：如何设计AI禁止的评估关卡作为类型分离制度，以及如何将AI整合到培训中以促进互补型使用而非替代型使用。

title: Quality of Healthy Work Environment and Related Factors in Clinical Nurses: A Structural Equation Modeling
affiliations: Sahmyook University and Sahmyook University

detail.title: Quality of Healthy Work Environment and Related Factors in Clinical Nurses: A Structural Equation Modeling
detail.abstract: Background: This study examined factors associated with the quality of healthy work environments (HWE) among clinical nurses in South Korea using structural equation modeling based on Ferrans’ Health-Related Quality of Life Model. Objective: To identify factors influencing HWE quality and test a structural equation model. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted with 299 nurses from general hospitals in Seoul and Gyeonggi. Data were collected using validated questionnaires measuring nursing need satisfaction, job satisfaction, nursing performance, subjective health status, nursing work environment, and HWE quality. Confirmatory factor analysis supported the validity of the measurement model. Results: Nursing need satisfaction (β = .19, p < .01) and job satisfaction (β = .64, p < .001) were positively associated with the nursing work environment, which was significantly related to HWE quality (β = .26, p < .05). Nursing performance had a direct association with HWE quality (β = .15, p < .01). Job satisfaction showed both direct and indirect effects on HWE quality. The model explained 45% of the variance in the nursing work environment and 51% in HWE quality. Conclusion: Strategies including educational programs, leadership training, and workload optimization may improve HWE quality, nurse retention, and patient care outcomes.

AI.tldr: 基于Ferrans健康相关生活质量模型，本研究通过结构方程模型分析了韩国临床护士健康工作环境质量的影响因素，发现护理需求满足、工作满意度、护理绩效和工作环境对HWE质量有显著影响，模型解释了51%的HWE质量方差。
AI.research_question: 影响韩国临床护士健康工作环境质量的因素有哪些？各因素之间的作用路径和效应如何？
AI.motivation: 健康工作环境对护士留任和患者护理质量至关重要，但影响HWE质量的多因素复杂机制尚需系统研究，尤其是基于理论模型的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ferrans健康相关生活质量模型
AI.method: 横断面研究设计，对韩国首尔和京畿道综合医院的299名护士进行问卷调查，采用验证性因子分析支持测量模型有效性，通过结构方程模型分析变量间关系。
AI.findings: 护理需求满足（β=.19, p<.01）和工作满意度（β=.64, p<.001）与护理工作环境呈正相关；工作环境显著关联HWE质量（β=.26, p<.05）；护理绩效直接正向影响HWE质量（β=.15, p<.01）；工作满意度对HWE质量既有直接效应也有间接效应；模型解释护理工作环境45%的方差和HWE质量51%的方差。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Ferrans健康相关生活质量模型应用于护理工作环境领域，验证了该模型在解释HWE质量形成机制中的适用性，揭示了护理需求满足、工作满意度、护理绩效等变量间的路径关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善护理工作环境质量提供了实证依据，建议通过教育培训、领导力培训和优化工作负荷等策略提升HWE质量、促进护士留任并改善患者护理结果。

title: Birch Bark Biocomposite Filament for Additive Manufacturing: Properties, Comparative Analysis, Economic Outlook and Applications
affiliations: Russian Academy of National Economy and Public Administration under the President of the Russian Federation (RANEPA)

detail.title: Birch Bark Biocomposite Filament for Additive Manufacturing: Properties, Comparative Analysis, Economic Outlook and Applications
detail.abstract: Birch bark (Betula pendula Roth.) outer bark is an abundant forestry by-product whose primary constituent, the biopolyester suberin, imparts exceptional hydrophobicity, UV resistance and intrinsic antimicrobial activity. Despite growing interest in plant-based biocomposite filaments for fused deposition modelling (FDM), birch bark has not yet been systematically evaluated as a filler for polylactic acid (PLA) filament. This study presents a conceptual and literaturebased characterisation of birch bark/PLA biocomposite filaments (10-20 wt.% filler) and benchmarks their projected properties against established wood-based FDM filaments (sawdust/PLA, bamboo/PLA and cork/PLA). Key physicochemical and mechanical parameters examined include density, tensile strength, Young's modulus, flexural strength, water absorption, moisture resistance and biodegradability. Projected tensile strength of 38-46 MPa and density of 1.15-1.22 g/cm³ position the birch-bark composite as superior to cork/PLA in strength while approaching wood/PLA values, with markedly better moisture resistance than cellulose-rich fillers. An economic analysis reveals that the global biocomposite market, valued at USD 33-44 billion in 2025 (CAGR ~14-18 %), and the 3D printing filament market, expected to reach USD 3.2-26.8 billion by 2031-2035, together constitute a significant commercial opportunity. Raw material costs are additionally favourable because outer bark represents industrial waste currently incinerated in pulp mills. Prospective application domains encompass sustainable packaging, cultural heritage restoration, interior design, biomedical auxiliaries and educational models. The results support further experimental investigation of birch-bark/PLA filament and its integration into both industrial manufacturing and traditional craft revival programmes.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了桦树皮外皮（主要成分为木栓质）作为聚乳酸（PLA）3D打印线材填料的可行性。通过文献综述和概念性表征，预测含10-20 wt.%桦树皮的PLA复合线材的抗拉强度为38-46 MPa，密度为1.15-1.22 g/cm³，在强度上优于软木/PLA复合材料，接近木材/PLA复合材料，且耐湿性显著优于富含纤维素的填料。研究还指出全球生物复合材料和3D打印线材市场潜力巨大，且原料（桦树外皮）为造纸工业废料，成本优势明显。潜在应用包括可持续包装、文化修复、室内设计、生物医学辅助和教育模型。
AI.research_question: 桦树皮外皮（Betula pendula Roth.）能否作为PLA 3D打印线材的有效填料？其理化、力学性能与现有木质基FDM线材相比如何？
AI.motivation: 桦树皮外皮是林业副产品，含有天然生物聚酯——木栓质，赋予其疏水性、抗紫外线和抗菌活性，但尚未被系统评估为FDM打印PLA线材的填料。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于植物基生物复合材料的填料-基体相互作用理论，以及木栓质的疏水特性对复合材料力学性能和水分阻隔性能的影响机制。
AI.method: 概念性和文献综述性的方法，对桦树皮/PLA复合线材（10-20 wt.%填料）进行性能预测，并与已有的木质基FDM线材（锯末/PLA、竹/PLA、软木/PLA）进行基准对比。
AI.findings: （1）桦树皮/PLA复合线材预测抗拉强度38-46 MPa，密度1.15-1.22 g/cm³；（2）强度优于软木/PLA，接近木材/PLA；（3）耐湿性显著优于纤维素基填料；（4）全球生物复合材料市场（2025年330-440亿美元）和3D打印线材市场（2031-2035年32-268亿美元）提供巨大商业机会；（5）原料为工业废料（纸浆厂焚烧物），成本优势显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提出桦树皮外皮作为PLA线材填料的理论框架，并基于木栓质的疏水特性解释了其复合材料的潜在性能优势。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为开发新型可持续FDM线材提供理论依据和性能基准；（2）为林业废料（桦树外皮）的高值化利用提供新路径；（3）潜在应用领域涉及可持续包装、文化遗产修复、室内设计、生物医学辅助和教育模型；（4）支持传统工艺复兴和工业制造的结合。

title: Dual Representation of Robust Risk Measures and Uncertainty Sets
affiliations: Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS) and

detail.title: Dual Representation of Robust Risk Measures and Uncertainty Sets
detail.abstract: We consider robust risk measures that arise as worst-case values of convex risk measures evaluated on uncertainty sets. We characterize continuity properties of robust risk measures through their consolidated uncertainty sets, derive dual representations for robust risk measures, and develop a set-valued dual representation for consolidated uncertainty sets. The two dual frameworks rely on distinct geometric assumptions and are therefore complementary rather than interchangeable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于凸风险测度在不确定集上的最坏情况值所构建的鲁棒风险测度，刻画了其连续性、对偶表示及集值对偶表示等性质。
AI.research_question: 如何刻画鲁棒风险测度（作为凸风险测度在不确定集上的最坏情况值）的连续性、对偶表示及其整合不确定集的集值对偶表示？
AI.motivation: 鲁棒风险测度在金融风险管理中具有重要应用，但其连续性和对偶表示等核心性质尚未被充分刻画，特别是两种对偶框架之间的关系和互补性有待厘清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凸风险测度理论、鲁棒优化、对偶表示理论、集值分析
AI.method: 理论推导与数学证明，通过整合不确定集的概念刻画鲁棒风险测度的连续性，并分别建立两种对偶表示框架（基于不同几何假设）。
AI.findings: (1) 通过整合不确定集刻画了鲁棒风险测度的连续性特征；(2) 推导了鲁棒风险测度的对偶表示；(3) 建立了整合不确定集的集值对偶表示；(4) 揭示了两种对偶框架基于不同几何假设、具有互补性而非可互换性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为鲁棒风险测度提供了系统的连续性刻画和对偶表示理论，明确了两种对偶框架的适用条件与互补关系，丰富和完善了鲁棒风险度量理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融风险管理中鲁棒风险测度的实际应用提供了理论支撑，帮助实践者理解不同对偶框架的适用场景，从而更有效地进行风险度量与决策。

title: Securing the Future to Risk the Present? Retirement Plans and Entrepreneurial Risk-taking
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Lowell - Department of Finance and

detail.title: Securing the Future to Risk the Present? Retirement Plans and Entrepreneurial Risk-taking
detail.abstract:
This paper examines whether small business owners' adoption of retirement plans (SEP IRA, Solo
401(k)) influences risk-taking behavior in their primary ventures. We hypothesize that securing
personal retirement reduces background financial anxiety, potentially enabling more aggressive
business strategies, a mechanism grounded in the background risk literature. Using the 2019 and
2022 waves of the Survey of Consumer Finances and administrative records from Department of
Labor Form 5500 filings, we measure business risk-taking through three outcomes: financial
leverage, capital investment intensity, and wealth concentration. We exploit the December 2019
SECURE Act as a policy discontinuity, employing a difference-in-differences design that
compares plan-adopting and non-adopting owners before and after the Act's passage.
Our preliminary findings do not detect statistically significant associations between retirement plan
adoption and business risk-taking across any of our three outcome measures, in either cross-
sectional or difference-in-differences specifications. However, the leverage coefficient is
consistently positive across all specifications, directionally consistent with the background risk
hypothesis. Heterogeneity analysis reveals a potentially important age dynamic: owners over 50
who adopt retirement plans exhibit lower leverage relative to younger adopters (coefficient -0.111,
p = 0.134), suggesting that for retirement-vulnerable older owners, plan adoption may operate as
a conservative financial anchor rather than a risk-enabling mechanism. Owners with high prior
wealth concentration in their business show positive but insignificant effects, consistent with the
hypothesized mechanism.
We interpret these null results as informative rather than conclusive. The two-wave design, while
exploiting a clean policy discontinuity, may be insufficient to detect behavioral changes that
operate over longer horizons. These results motivate a richer research design using restricted-
access SCF geographic files, additional survey waves, and Census-linked administrative data. Our
findings contribute to the literature on household finance and entrepreneurship by providing the
first direct empirical test of the retirement security and entrepreneurial risk-taking nexus, and by
identifying heterogeneity by owner age that challenges uniform application of the background risk
mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2019年和2022年SCF数据及劳工部表格5500行政记录，采用双重差分法研究小企业主采用退休计划（SEP IRA、Solo 401(k)）对其主要创业企业风险承担行为的影响。初步未发现显著的统计关联，但杠杆系数方向一致为正；进一步异质性分析表明，50岁以上采用者的杠杆率更低，提示退休计划对年龄较大的企业主可能发挥保守锚定而非风险赋能的作用。
AI.research_question: 小企业主采用退休计划（SEP IRA、Solo 401(k)）是否会影响其主营企业的风险承担行为？
AI.motivation: 现有背景风险文献指出，个人财务安全感的提升可能促使个体承担更多商业风险，但退休计划与企业主风险行为之间关系的直接实证检验尚属空白。本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 背景风险理论（background risk literature）：个人退休保障降低了财务焦虑，从而可能使企业主采取更为激进的商业策略。
AI.method: 数据来源：2019和2022年SCF数据、劳工部表格5500行政记录。识别策略：利用2019年12月SECURE法案作为政策断点，采用双重差分法对比采用与未采用退休计划的企业主在法案前后的行为变化。风险承担度量：财务杠杆、资本投资强度、财富集中度。
AI.findings: 1）三个风险承担指标均未发现统计显著关联；2）杠杆系数在所有设定中均为正，方向支持背景风险假说；3）50岁以上采用者杠杆率低于年轻采用者（系数-0.111，p=0.134），表明退休计划对年龄较大者可能起到保守锚定作用；4）企业财富集中度高的所有者效应为正但不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对退休保障与创业风险承担之间的关系进行直接实证检验，并发现企业主年龄带来的异质性，挑战了背景风险机制的统一适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解退休计划对小微企业主行为的影响提供初步证据，提示退休政策的激励效应可能因所有者年龄而异。

title: Job Satisfaction and Organizational Commitment as Determinants of Intention to Leave and Employee Attrition: Evidence from the Steel Industry of Chhattisgarh
affiliations: and AMITY UNIVERSITY CHHATTISGARH

detail.title: Job Satisfaction and Organizational Commitment as Determinants of Intention to Leave and Employee Attrition: Evidence from the Steel Industry of Chhattisgarh
detail.abstract: Employee attrition remains one of the most operationally disruptive and financially costly challenges facing organizations in steel manufacturing. This study empirically examines the determinants of employee attrition in the steel industry of Chhattisgarh, India, focusing on job satisfaction (JS) and organizational commitment (OC) as primary antecedents, mediated through intention to leave (ITL). A structured questionnaire was administered to 120 employees drawn through stratified random sampling across managerial, supervisory, and workmen strata. Primary data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM). All five directional hypotheses were supported. JS (beta =-0.214, p < 0.05) and OC (beta =-0.311, p < 0.01) each exerted significant negative effects on ITL. ITL demonstrated an exceptionally strong positive effect on actual attrition (beta = 0.703, p < 0.001). Mediation analyses confirmed that ITL significantly mediates both the JS-attrition and OC-attrition pathways. Strata-wise analysis revealed that workmen exhibit the highest attrition risk (ITL mean = 3.11), while managerial employees are the most satisfied and committed. These findings contribute context-specific empirical evidence to the retention literature and offer actionable recommendations for HR practitioners in the steel sector.

title: Equity Returns with a Trailing Stop-Loss
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Equity Returns with a Trailing Stop-Loss

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No other individuals or organizations have influenced this study.

detail.abstract: This paper studies the effect of a trailing stop-loss on equity returns and risk. Explicit expressions are derived for the expected return, variance and Sharpe ratio under geometric Brownian motion and a regime-switching model. Under constant drift, the results suggest that a trailing stop-loss is generally detrimental despite limiting drawdowns. However, when market conditions can deteriorate or when the sign of the drift is uncertain, a trailing stop-loss can increase expected return while reducing P&L volatility. The paper also shows how to optimise the trailing stop-loss level for either expected return or Sharpe ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了追踪止损对股票收益和风险的影响，发现在恒定漂移下追踪止损通常不利，但在市场条件恶化或漂移方向不确定时，追踪止损能提高预期收益并降低波动。
AI.research_question: 追踪止损如何影响股票资产的预期收益、风险（方差）和夏普比率？
AI.motivation: 追踪止损是实践中广泛使用但理论上研究不足的风险管理工具，本文旨在填补其收益-风险效应的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于几何布朗运动（GBM）和机制转换模型（regime-switching model）的定价与风险管理理论框架。
AI.method: 通过数学推导得出追踪止损下预期收益、方差和夏普比率的解析表达式，并进行优化分析。
AI.findings: (1) 恒定漂移下，追踪止损尽管能限制回撤，但总体上损害收益-风险表现；(2) 市场条件恶化或漂移方向不确定时，追踪止损能同时提高预期收益并降低盈亏波动；(3) 可通过优化追踪止损水平来最大化预期收益或夏普比率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在GBM和机制转换框架下为追踪止损的收益-风险效应提供解析解，揭示了其在不同市场条件下的条件有效边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了优化追踪止损水平的理论依据，帮助判断何时使用追踪止损利大于弊。

title: The Determining Factors of Work Life Balance and the Impacts on Academic Engagement Among Working University Students by PLS-SEM Approach
affiliations: and Sampoerna University

detail.title: The Determining Factors of Work Life Balance and the Impacts on Academic Engagement Among Working University Students by PLS-SEM Approach
detail.abstract: The increased phenomenon of university students who take professional working jobs outside the university academic responsibilities creates a need to explore and understand the factors which contributing into their success, both in their financial, life balance, and academic engagement. This study aims to examine the impact of Role Clarity, Workplace Culture and Environment, and Stress Management on Work-Life Balance to see the forward effect on the students' academic engagement. The quantitative approach is used to determine the data gained from 70 working university students, by implementing the PLS-SEM Algorithm in SmartPLS 4 software. The purification and bootstrapping methods are also used in the analysis process. The results of this study showed that the Workplace Culture and Environment had the biggest significant positive impact on Work-Life Balance. However, the Stress Management showed no significant effect on statistics. While the Work-Life Balance is significantly affecting the students' Academic Engagement, it is negative due to the indicator phrasing. Moreover, the model showed that the variances were on the value of 46.2% on Work-Life Balance and 51.2% on Academic Engagement. Hence, this study concludes that the Workplace Culture and Environment is more vital to maintain the students' Work Life Balance than the individual strategy of stress management, which suggests the need for workplace flexibility.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了70名在职大学生，发现工作场所文化与环境对工作生活平衡的影响最大，而压力管理无显著影响。工作生活平衡虽显著影响学术参与度，但为负向关系。模型解释了工作生活平衡46.2%和学术参与度51.2%的方差。
AI.research_question: 角色清晰度、工作场所文化与环境、压力管理如何影响在职大学生的工作生活平衡，进而影响其学术参与度？
AI.motivation: 越来越多的大学生承担校外专业工作，有必要探索和理解影响他们在财务、生活平衡和学术参与方面成功的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色清晰度、工作场所文化与环境、压力管理对工作生活平衡的影响，以及工作生活平衡对学术参与度的影响。
AI.method: 定量方法，对70名在职大学生进行问卷调查，使用SmartPLS 4软件进行PLS-SEM算法分析，并采用纯化和自助法（Bootstrapping）进行数据处理。
AI.findings: 工作场所文化与环境对工作生活平衡有最大的显著正向影响；压力管理无显著统计效果；工作生活平衡显著但负向影响学术参与度（由于指标措辞问题）；模型对工作生活平衡的解释方差为46.2%，对学术参与度为51.2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在职大学生群体中，工作场所环境因素（外部）比个体压力管理策略（内部）对工作生活平衡更重要，扩展了工作生活平衡与学术参与关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议用人单位为在职大学生提供工作场所灵活性，而非仅依赖学生的个人压力管理策略，以更好地维持其工作生活平衡和学术参与。

title: Food Banks and New Technologies: The Case of FoodFinder
affiliations: University of West Attica

detail.title: Food Banks and New Technologies: The Case of FoodFinder
detail.abstract: Food waste is a major social and environmental problem. At the same time, many people struggle to meet basic nutritional needs. Food Banks contribute to reducing food waste by collecting and distributing food to individuals and families in need. In recent years, new technologies have significantly helped the operation of these organizations through digital platforms and applications. This paper presents the role of Food Banks and examines the FoodFinder application as a case study. The application helps users locate food supply structures in their area, utilizing digital maps and geolocation services. The results show that technology can effectively support social service actions and facilitate citizens' access to food assistance services.

AI.tldr: 本文以FoodFinder应用为案例，探讨数字技术如何通过地理定位服务帮助食物银行更高效地收集和分配食物，以减少食物浪费并帮助有需要的人群获取食物援助。
AI.research_question: 数字技术（特别是地理定位应用）如何支持食物银行的运作，并帮助有需要的公民获取食物援助服务？
AI.motivation: 食物浪费是严重的社会和环境问题，同时许多人面临基本营养需求无法满足的困境。食物银行在减少浪费和提供援助方面发挥重要作用，但如何通过新技术提升其效能是一个值得探索的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 食物银行运作理论、数字技术赋能社会服务的理论框架、地理信息系统（GIS）在社会服务中的应用理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以FoodFinder应用程序为具体案例，分析其通过数字地图和地理定位服务帮助用户定位食物供应设施的功能与效果。
AI.findings: 技术能够有效支持社会服务行动，帮助公民更方便地获取食物援助服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字技术在社会服务（特别是食物援助）领域应用的理论认识，为技术赋能社会福利提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食物银行等社会组织如何利用数字平台和定位技术提升运营效率提供了可借鉴的实践案例；FoodFinder应用可作为推广模板，帮助更多有需要的人获取食物援助。

title: Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities in Cloud-Assisted Autonomous Vehicle Routing: Backdoor Attacks on AI Super Networks for Route Manipulation

detail.title: Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities in Cloud-Assisted Autonomous Vehicle Routing: Backdoor Attacks on AI Super Networks for Route Manipulation
detail.abstract: The integration of cloud-assisted artificial intelligence into autonomous vehicle (AV) routing systems promises unprecedented gains in traffic efficiency, energy optimization, and real-time hazard avoidance. However, this architectural shift introduces a critical and underexplored attack surface: the AI super network-a federated or centralized deep learning backbone that fuses global traffic data, vehicular telemetry, and environmental sensors to compute optimal routes. In this work, we expose a novel class of cybersecurity threats wherein adversaries inject backdoor triggers into the training or inference pipeline of these super networks, enabling stealthy, large-scale route manipulation. Unlike conventional GPS spoofing or denial-ofservice attacks, backdoor attacks remain dormant under normal conditions and are activated only by specific spatiotemporal patterns (e.g., subtle weather artifacts, digital map overlays, or synchronized beacon signals), causing targeted AVs to reroute into congested zones, restricted areas, or collision-prone corridors without triggering anomaly detectors. We formalize a threat model for cloud-assisted AV routing, propose three backdoor injection strategies-trainingdata poisoning, model-weight trojaning via federated updates, and adversarial input perturbation during inference-and evaluate their effectiveness on a simulated urban-scale routing environment using real-world traffic datasets. Our results demonstrate that a single backdoor trigger can divert up to 78% of affected AV fleets with less than 0.5% deviation in nominal routing metrics, evading both statistical and learning-based detection baselines. This research underscores that AI super networks, despite their intelligence, are brittle under coordinated backdoor compromise, demanding a paradigm shift in secure V2X (vehicle-toeverything) architecture design.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了云辅助AI超级网络（自动驾驶路由系统）面临的新型后门攻击威胁，攻击者可通过数据投毒、模型权重篡改和对抗性输入扰动三种策略植入隐形触发信号，在正常指标偏差小于0.5%的情况下，成功将高达78%的受影响自动驾驶车队诱导至危险区域，且能规避统计与学习检测基线。
AI.research_question: 云辅助AI超级网络（自动驾驶路由系统）如何受到后门攻击威胁？这类攻击如何实现大规模、隐蔽的路线操控？
AI.motivation: 随着云辅助AI融入自动驾驶车辆路由系统，虽然提升了交通效率、能量优化和实时避险能力，但由此引入的AI超级网络（融合全球交通数据、车辆遥测和环境传感器数据的深度学习骨干）成为新的攻击面。传统GPS欺骗和拒绝服务攻击已被广泛研究，但针对AI超级网络的后门攻击这一隐蔽威胁尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后门攻击理论、威胁建模、AI超级网络架构安全、V2X通信安全
AI.method: 提出了三种后门注入策略：训练数据投毒、通过联邦更新进行模型权重木马化、推理阶段对抗性输入扰动。在城市规模模拟路由环境中，使用真实交通数据集评估攻击效果。
AI.findings: 单个后门触发信号可导致高达78%受影响自动驾驶车队改道；路由指标偏差小于0.5%；能规避统计和基于学习的检测基线。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了面向云辅助自动驾驶路由的威胁模型；揭示了AI超级网络在协同后门攻击下的脆弱性；指出了安全V2X架构设计的范式转变需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶系统和V2X架构的安全设计提供警示，强调需针对AI超级网络的后门攻击建立防御机制；提出了新的攻击面需纳入安全评估体系。

title: Volatility Forecasting in Gold Futures: HAR Models, Options-Implied Volatility, and the Limits of Directional Inference

detail.title: Volatility Forecasting in Gold Futures: HAR Models, Options-Implied Volatility, and the Limits of Directional Inference

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethical approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author using publicly available and purchased research papers and commercially sourced market data.

detail.abstract: This paper implements and extends the Heterogeneous Autoregressive Realized Volatility (HAR-RV) framework for COMEX Gold futures (GC) using live daily data spanning 2021-2026. We augment the HAR benchmark with the CBOE Gold Volatility Index (GVZ), bipower variation jump decomposition, Ridge regression regularization, and geopolitical risk proxies, following Corsi (2009), Luo, Qin and Ye (2016), Wei, Liang et al. (2020), and Gkillas, Gupta and Pierdzioch (2020). Across seven competing specifications, GVZ-augmented models improve out-of-sample R² by 10-56 percentage points relative to the HAR-RV benchmark; Ridge regression achieves the largest improvement (+55.6%) though without conventional statistical significance under the Clark-West (2007) test. The AR-GVZ specification achieves marginal significance (p = 0.065). A key practitioner contribution distinguishes volatility forecast accuracy from tradeable directional edge: improved vol forecasts identify high-uncertainty regimes that inform position sizing and risk management but do not directly generate directional alpha in Gold futures. We document the conditions under which GVZ signals function as regime context rather than directional triggers, and discuss implications for systematic Gold trading strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2021-2026年COMEX黄金期货日度数据，扩展HAR-RV框架，加入GVZ、双幂变差跳跃分解、Ridge回归和地缘政治风险代理变量。GVZ增强模型将样本外R²提升10-56个百分点，但改进缺乏统计显著性；核心贡献在于区分波动率预测精度与交易方向性优势，指出GVZ信号主要提供市场状态背景而非直接方向性交易信号。
AI.research_question: GVZ（黄金波动率指数）能否提升COMEX黄金期货已实现波动率的预测精度？波动率预测精度的提升是否能够转化为可交易的方向性优势？
AI.motivation: 现有文献广泛使用HAR-RV框架预测波动率，但对GVZ在黄金期货中的预测价值、以及波动率预测精度与交易信号之间的关系缺乏系统探讨。本文旨在弥合这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: HAR-RV模型（Corsi, 2009）；波动率跳跃分解（Luo, Qin & Ye, 2016）；GVZ指数信息含量（Wei, Liang et al., 2020）；地缘政治风险与波动率（Gkillas, Gupta & Pierdzioch, 2020）；Clark-West（2007）预测比较检验。
AI.method: 使用2021-2026年日度COMEX黄金期货数据，构建7个竞争性HAR-RV扩展模型，包含GVZ、双幂变差跳跃项、Ridge正则化回归、地缘政治风险代理变量。采用样本外R²和Clark-West（2007）检验评估预测表现。
AI.findings: （1）GVZ增强模型样本外R²提升10-56个百分点；（2）Ridge回归提升最大（+55.6%），但Clark-West检验不显著；（3）AR-GVZ模型边际显著（p=0.065）；（4）波动率预测精度提升不直接转化为黄金期货的方向性交易优势（alpha），主要用于识别高不确定性状态以优化头寸管理和风险管理。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）系统比较了多种扩展HAR-RV模型在黄金期货波动率预测中的表现；（2）首次明确区分了波动率预测精度提升与方向性交易优势两种不同的预测价值维度；（3）揭示了GVZ信号作为"状态背景"而非"方向触发"的理论角色。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为黄金期货交易者提供波动率预测模型选择的实证依据；（2）阐明GVZ的实践使用条件——适用于头寸规模设定和风险管理，而非直接生成方向性交易信号；（3）对系统性黄金交易策略的设计提供重要启示。

title: California High-Speed Rail Construction Package 1: A Probabilistic Chain Analysis Autopsy
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: California High-Speed Rail Construction Package 1: A Probabilistic Chain Analysis Autopsy
detail.abstract: It constructs a Probabilistic Chain Analysis model on the 2008 baseline and shows that the probability of the actual outcome under the published framework's independence assumption was approximately one in a million. Under cascade modelling it was expected. The paper concludes with an executable PCA intervention protocol for the next phase. Not a recommendation. A procedure to run.

AI.tldr: 本文利用概率链分析（PCA）模型，基于2008年基线数据，证明在已发布框架的独立性假设下，实际结果发生的概率约为百万分之一；而在级联模型下，该结果则是可预期的。论文最后提供了一个可执行的PCA干预协议，供下一阶段使用——不是建议，而是一个可运行的程序。
AI.research_question: 在已发布的框架独立性假设下，实际结果发生的概率是多少？级联模型能否更好地解释实际结果？
AI.motivation: 现有框架的独立性假设可能严重低估了某些结果的发生概率，需要更精确的模型来理解和预测实际结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率链分析（PCA）模型；级联模型（Cascade Modelling）
AI.method: 构建概率链分析模型，基于2008年基线数据进行概率计算，比较独立性假设与级联模型下的结果概率差异。
AI.findings: 在独立性假设下，实际结果概率约为百万分之一；在级联模型下，该结果是可预期的。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了独立性假设在特定情境下的严重偏差，证明了级联模型在解释此类结果中的有效性，拓展了概率链分析方法的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可直接执行的PCA干预协议，为下一阶段实践操作提供了程序化工具，而非仅仅是理论建议。

title: Trading the Volatility Risk Premium on Nifty 50: Strategy Backtest with Realistic Frictions

detail.title: Trading the Volatility Risk Premium on Nifty 50: Strategy Backtest with Realistic Frictions
detail.abstract: Systematic sellers of variance risk on U.S. equity index options have long earned a positive risk premium, but whether that premium survives realistic transaction costs in an emerging market with a high Securities Transaction Tax (STT) and wide bid-ask spreads remains an open question. This paper tests four short-volatility strategies on Nifty 50 index options over 119 monthly expiry cycles from January 2015 to April 2025, applying a cost model that incorporates STT (0.05% on sell-side premium), brokerage (0.03% per leg), slippage (0.5% of premium), and, for the deltahedged variant, daily futures rebalancing costs (0.01% per trade). The four strategies examined are an ATM short straddle, a crash-neutral spread, a naked put-write at four moneyness levels (k = 0.94, 0.96, 0.98, 1.00), and a delta-hedged straddle. Net of all costs, every strategy produces negative annualized returns. The put-write at k = 0.94 is the least adverse outcome, with a 91.6% monthly win rate and an annualized return of-0.9% (Sharpe ratio-0.37); the straddle variants lose approximately 44 to 45% per year. Cost attribution confirms that transaction costs are a secondary factor; the primary driver of losses across all strategies is tail risk, with single-month drawdowns reaching-13.2% of margin for the straddle variants and-18.3% for the k = 0.98 put-write (Table 1). These findings imply that the volatility risk premium documented in Pillai (2026a) exists in Indian index options but is not capturable by a retail trader under current market microstructure.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了印度Nifty 50指数期权市场的四种做空波动率策略（2015-2025年），在考虑了证券交易税、经纪费、滑点和期货对冲成本后，所有策略均录得负年化收益。亏损主因并非交易成本，而是尾部风险事件。
AI.research_question: 在高证券交易税和宽买卖价差的新兴市场中，做空波动率策略在扣除真实交易成本后是否仍能获得正风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 美国市场中做空方差风险长期获得正溢价，但新兴市场（如印度）的高交易成本（STT、宽价差）是否使这一溢价不可捕获，尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率风险溢价理论；市场微观结构理论（交易成本对策略收益的影响）；尾部风险理论。
AI.method: 在Nifty 50指数期权上测试四种做空波动率策略（ATM跨式、崩盘中性价差、裸卖跌期权（四种货币性水平）、Delta对冲跨式），纳入STT（卖出端权利金的0.05%）、经纪费（每腿0.03%）、滑点（权利金的0.5%）及期货日频再平衡成本（0.01%/笔），覆盖2015年1月至2025年4月共119个月度到期周期。
AI.findings: 所有策略在扣除成本后均录得负年化收益；k=0.94卖跌期权损失最小（年化-0.9%，胜率91.6%，夏普比-0.37）；跨式期权损失约-44%至-45%；亏损主因为尾部风险（单月最大回撤达保证金的-18.3%），交易成本仅为次要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了新兴市场中波动率风险溢价的存在性（与Pillai, 2026a一致），但揭示了微观结构摩擦导致该溢价不可捕获，丰富了波动率风险溢价的边界条件理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售交易者和机构投资者提供了印度市场做空波动率策略的真实成本-收益基准，提示在高交易成本新兴市场中需警惕尾部风险对策略收益的侵蚀。

title: What Solo AI-Augmented Inventors Mean for Patent Systems
affiliations: Independent Inventor

detail.title: What Solo AI-Augmented Inventors Mean for Patent Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses public administrative records (Canadian Intellectual Property Office filings) and the author's own filing history; no human or animal subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All filing fees and compute (LLM subscription) costs were personally funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Large language models are collapsing the marginal cost of producing a patent application, shifting the binding constraint for individual inventors from professional drafting to the throughput of the filing office. We use a documented existence proof — one inventor filing 75 applications with a single office over 96 days using a two-model AI pipeline — to structure a forward-looking analysis of the consequences for patent systems. Drawing on the verified trace of that deployment, we argue the most immediate effects are not doctrinal questions about machine inventorship but practical pressures: a redistribution of office workload toward formalities and correspondence (the office issued substantive notices on only 8% of applications, while a self-inflicted configuration error propagated to 27%); new disclosure and prior-art-integrity questions raised by human-directed, machine-drafted volume; the dual use of automation for defensive disclosure and offensive thickets (41% of applications were cross-linked); an unresolved distributional question about who benefits; and a novel, correlated failure mode in which one setup error replicates across a portfolio. We set out a neutral menu of policy options, much of it observable in offices' own administrative data, and discuss the limits of reasoning from a single case.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个实际案例（一位发明人在96天内使用双模型AI流程提交75份专利申请）分析了大型语言模型对专利体系的冲击：边际成本骤降使核心约束从专业撰写转向审查办公吞吐量，带来了工作量重新分配、披露质量、双重用途、分配公平和系统性故障等实际问题，并提出了政策选择菜单。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型降低专利申请边际成本后，将对专利体系产生哪些直接、实际的冲击？政策应如何回应？
AI.motivation: LLM正使专利申请的边际成本崩塌，这将对专利审查办公室的运作、披露质量、申请策略等产生深远影响，但现有讨论多聚焦于机器发明权这一理论问题，缺乏对更紧迫的实践压力的关注。作者通过一个可验证的极端案例（一人96天提交75份申请）来结构化分析这些影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约束条件转移理论（从专业起草的约束转向审查办公吞吐量的约束）、双重用途理论（防御性披露与进攻性专利丛林的自动化应用）、系统故障相关性理论（单一配置错误在组合中复制传播）
AI.method: 单一案例存在性证明（documented existence proof），基于可验证的AI管线部署痕迹（双模型AI流程，75份申请提交给单一办公室，历时96天），结合行政数据分析。
AI.findings: (1) 审查办公室工作量向形式审查和通信事务重新分配（仅8%收到实质审查通知，27%因自我配置错误被驳回）；(2) 人类指导、机器起草的大规模申请引发新的披露和现有技术完整性疑问；(3) 自动化兼具防御性公开和进攻性专利丛林的两种用途（41%申请交叉关联）；(4) 存在未解决的分配公平问题（谁真正受益）；(5) 出现新型相关故障模式——单个设置错误在整个组合中传播复制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"约束条件转移"作为理解LLM对专利体系冲击的核心理论框架；识别"相关故障模式"这一新型系统性风险；将双重用途理论扩展到专利自动化的情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专利审查办公室提供了可操作的政策选择菜单（多数可从行政数据中观测）；提醒监管者关注形式审查负荷、披露完整性、配置错误系统性扩散等实际问题，而非仅聚焦于机器发明权的理论辩论。

title: Beyond Technological Convergence: ESG Discourse Dominance and Channel-Conditional Emotional Framing in Mega-Capitalized Corporate Reports (2024-2025)

detail.title: Beyond Technological Convergence: ESG Discourse Dominance and Channel-Conditional Emotional Framing in Mega-Capitalized Corporate Reports (2024-2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no personal or financial conflicts of interest. The study relies exclusively on publicly available secondary data from official corporate disclosure sources.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available secondary data and involves no human or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Background: The post-2024 commercialization of generative artificial intelligence (AI) and the concurrent tightening of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) regulatory regimes have created competing institutional pressures on corporate disclosure. The relative dominance of these competing narratives, and the extent to which their emotional framing differs across communication channels, remains empirically contested. Objectives: This study identifies the dominant institutional narrative in mega-capitalized corporate discourse and tests whether emotional valence differs systematically between financial and ESG reporting channels. 
Methods: Quantitative content analysis combined with automated sentiment analysis (TextBlob) was conducted on 290 corporate documents from publicly traded firms (market capitalization > USD 100 billion) published 2024-2025. Methodological controls included word-boundary regular-expression matching, NLTK Punkt sentence tokenization, document-length normalization (mentions per 1,000 words), and content-based report-type classification. Inferential testing used one-way ANOVA, Welch's ttest (unequal variances), and chi-square, with effect sizes reported as Cohen's d, Cramér's V, and etasquared.
 Findings: Contrary to prevailing assumptions of AI-driven discursive dominance, ESG language emerged as the most frequent institutional narrative (M = 1.55 mentions per 1,000 words; SD = 2.74), exceeding technological references (M = 1.19; SD = 1.89) and traditional firm-centric narratives (Supply Chain Resilience M = 0.50; Shareholder Primacy M = 0.49). All four narratives appeared in 83-95% of documents, indicating broad coexistence rather than singular convergence. Emotional valence diverged significantly by report type: ESG reports were systematically more positive than financial filings (M = 0.073 vs. M = 0.053; Welch t =-6.15, p < .001, Cohen's d =-0.82). This asymmetry persisted for technology-specific sentiment (Cohen's d =-0.66). Chi-square testing confirmed that report type and valence category are statistically dependent (χ² = 24.24, p < .001, Cramér's V = 0.29). 
Conclusions: ESG-not technology-is the dominant institutional discourse in mega-capitalized corporate communication during 2024-2025. The communication paradox manifests not through lexical convergence on AI vocabulary but through channel-conditional emotional framing, in which firms modulate emotional valence to meet differential stakeholder expectations. These results challenge a widespread assumption about AI-era corporate disclosure and suggest that ESG regulatory pressure has produced stronger institutional convergence than the generative-AI hype cycle.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在后2024年的大市值企业披露中，ESG语言（而非AI语言）成为主导性制度叙事；企业并非在词汇层面趋同于AI，而是通过不同沟通渠道（财务报告 vs. ESG报告）系统性地调节情感效价，以满足差异化的利益相关者期望。
AI.research_question: 在大市值企业的公司披露中，哪种制度叙事占据主导地位？财务报告与ESG报告之间的情感效价是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的商业化与ESG监管趋严同时发生，形成了相互竞争的制度压力；这两种叙事在披露中的相对主导性及其情绪框架在不同沟通渠道上的差异尚缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（制度压力与叙事竞争）；情感框架理论（情绪效价作为利益相关者管理工具）。
AI.method: 对290份市值超1000亿美元企业的2024-2025年公司文件进行定量内容分析与自动化情感分析（TextBlob），采用词边界正则表达式匹配、NLTK Punkt句子分词、文档长度归一化、内容报告分类；使用单因素ANOVA、Welch t检验、卡方检验，效应量报告Cohen's d、Cramér's V和η²。
AI.findings: ESG语言出现频率最高（M=1.55次/千词），超过技术语言（M=1.19）及传统叙事（供应链韧性M=0.50，股东至上M=0.49）；四大叙事共存于83-95%的文档中。情感效价在报告类型间显著分化：ESG报告比财务报告更积极（正性效价更高），技术相关情感也存在同样不对称性；报告类型与情感类别显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"AI时代企业披露将被技术叙事主导"的普遍假设，揭示了制度压力竞争下ESG监管的更强收敛效应；提出"沟通悖论"概念——企业通过渠道条件性情感框架而非词汇趋同来管理多元制度压力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者提供证据：ESG监管压力产生了实质性的制度趋同效应；为投资者和分析师揭示企业跨渠道情感管理策略，提醒注意不同报告类型的情绪偏倚。

title: Data-Driven Transfer Evaluation in the Bundesliga: A Production Function Analysis of FC Augsburg's Transfer Efficiency 2021–2024

detail.title: Data-Driven Transfer Evaluation in the Bundesliga: A Production Function Analysis of FC Augsburg's Transfer Efficiency 2021–2024
detail.abstract: This paper examines the transfer efficiency of FC Augsburg, a mid-table Bundesliga club, across three seasons from 2021 to 2024. Using a Weighted Attacking Production Index(WAPI) grounded in the Expected Threat framework of Singh (2018), we evaluate the attacking contribution per euro of transfer fee for all incoming signings with sufficient playing time. An OLS regression across a six-club panel (n = 18) indicates that gross transfer expenditure explains only 2.7% of Bundesliga points variance (p = 0.516), while defensive stability explains 55.1% when included as a co-predictor (p = 0.001). Analysis of individual signings reveals that Augsburg’s most expensive permanent acquisitions—Ricardo Pepi (€16.36M) and Niklas Dorsch (€7M) — delivered the lowest WAPI value scores in the dataset, while the highest-value acquisition (Mergim Berisha, €300K loan) produced 384 times more WAPI per euro than Pepi. Three illustrative counterfactual scenarios, drawn from the 2. Bundesliga and adjusted for league strength following Laseketal. (2013),demonstrate normalised WAPI improvements of 6.2 to 13.9 times at aggregate fee savings of €18.86 million. The findings suggest that positional allocation of spend — rather than expenditure volume — is the primary driver of transfer efficiency at mid-table level, and that publicly available data is sufficient to identify meaningful market inefficiencies prior to transfer decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文以德甲中游俱乐部奥格斯堡为对象，研究其2021-2024赛季的转会效率。通过加权进攻产出指数（WAPI）和OLS回归分析发现，转会支出总额仅能解释联赛积分变异的2.7%，而防守稳定性可解释55.1%。最贵的引援（佩皮、多施）WAPI价值最低，而最划算的引援（贝里沙）每欧元产出是佩皮的384倍。研究认为，资金的位置分配比支出总额更能影响转会效率。
AI.research_question: 德甲中游俱乐部（以奥格斯堡为例）的转会投入效率如何？转会支出总额与资金位置分配对联赛表现的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 足球产业中转会支出持续攀升，但关于中游俱乐部（非豪门）转会效率的研究相对匮乏。作者希望通过公开数据识别市场中的无效率现象，为中小预算俱乐部提供可操作的转会决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Singh（2018）的预期威胁框架（Expected Threat），构建加权进攻产出指数（WAPI）；参考Lasek et al.（2013）的联赛强度调整方法进行可比性分析。
AI.method: 1）构建WAPI指标评估每位引援每欧元转会费的进攻贡献；2）对六家俱乐部面板数据（n=18）进行OLS回归，分析转会支出与防守稳定性对联赛积分的解释力；3）通过三个反事实场景（从德乙选取替代引援）进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1）转会支出总额仅解释联赛积分变异的2.7%（p=0.516），不显著；2）加入防守稳定性作为协变量后，可解释55.1%（p=0.001）；3）奥格斯堡最贵的两名永久转会球员（佩皮€16.36M、多施€7M）WAPI得分最低；4）最划算引援（贝里沙€300K租借）每欧元WAPI产出是佩皮的384倍；5）反事实场景显示，通过更优选择可在节省€1886万总额的情况下，实现WAPI提升6.2-13.9倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预期威胁框架（Expected Threat）应用于转会效率分析，提出了以WAPI为核心的量化评估方法，拓展了足球管理领域关于"支出结构而非支出总额"影响球队表现的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德甲中游俱乐部提供了实证依据：转会决策中应更关注资金的位置分配（如优先投资防守稳定性），而非单纯追求高价引援；同时证明了公开数据足以识别转会市场中的重大效率偏差，有助于中小预算俱乐部优化引援策略。

title: Architectural Coherence in AI-Generated Patent Portfolios: A Case Study of Cross-Cluster Structure
affiliations: Independent Inventor

detail.title: Architectural Coherence in AI-Generated Patent Portfolios: A Case Study of Cross-Cluster Structure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses public administrative records (Canadian Intellectual Property Office filings) and the author's own filing history; no human or animal subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All filing fees and compute (LLM subscription) costs were personally funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Patent portfolios range from heaps of unrelated inventions to architectures whose components reference and reinforce one another. Architecture is normally a firm-scale, deliberately resourced achievement. We examine a portfolio of 75 applications filed by a single inventor over 96 days using AI-assisted drafting, in which 41% of applications carry explicit cross-cluster relationships and one cluster pair exhibits a systematic parent–child mapping between energy (vehicle-to-grid) inventions and corresponding post-quantum-security inventions, including named but unfilled gaps. We define architectural coherence by analogy with modularity and architectural innovation, document it at the portfolio and cluster-pair levels, and argue — against the narrative of spontaneous machine emergence — that the coherence is best understood as human architectural intent executed cheaply by an AI pipeline. The broader implication is that AI-assisted drafting may move portfolio architecture from a firm-scale to an individual-scale capability, with consequences for how portfolio structure is read and for what the empirical study of innovation should measure. We discuss the limits of inferring structure from a single, inventor-coded portfolio.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了一位发明家利用AI辅助工具在96天内提交的75项专利组合，发现其中41%的申请存在跨集群关系，并识别出能源与后量子安全发明之间的系统化父子映射。研究表明，AI辅助起草可能将专利组合架构从企业规模的能力转变为个人规模的能力，且这种架构连贯性源于人类的设计意图，而非机器的自发涌现。
AI.research_question: AI辅助起草如何影响发明家个人层面的专利组合架构连贯性？专利组合中的架构连贯性是如何产生并体现的？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为专利组合架构是企业层面有意识投入资源才能实现的成就，但AI辅助起草技术的兴起可能改变这一格局，使得个人发明家也能构建具有架构连贯性的专利组合。本研究旨在探讨这一新兴现象及其对创新研究的意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 架构连贯性（通过类比模块化和架构创新来定义）；人类设计意图与机器自发涌现的对比叙事。
AI.method: 对一位发明家使用AI辅助工具在96天内提交的75项专利申请进行案例分析，量化分析跨集群关系比例（41%），并深入分析一个集群对（能源/车辆到电网发明与后量子安全发明之间）的系统化父子映射关系。
AI.findings: 1）75项申请中41%存在明确的跨集群关系；2）识别出一个集群对存在系统化的父子映射，即能源（车辆到电网）发明与对应的后量子安全发明之间存在有命名的但未填补的空白；3）这种架构连贯性是人类设计意图通过AI流水线低成本执行的产物，而非机器的自发涌现。
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑了"机器自发涌现"的叙事，主张架构连贯性源于人类设计意图；将专利组合架构从企业规模能力重新定位为个人规模能力；为实证创新研究提供了测量结构的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了AI辅助起草可能彻底改变专利组合构建的规模经济，使个人发明家能够实现以往仅企业才能完成的架构化专利布局；提醒专利分析者和创新研究者在解读专利组合结构时需考虑AI辅助起草的影响。

title: How Labor Market Competition Shapes Workplace Information on Social Media: Evidence from Glassdoor Reviews
affiliations: Shanghai Jiaotong University, Singapore Management University - School of Accountancy and Singapore Management University - School of Accountancy

detail.title: How Labor Market Competition Shapes Workplace Information on Social Media: Evidence from Glassdoor Reviews

declarations.funderStatement: Li acknowledges funding from Shanghai Pujiang Program (25PJC047). Wang acknowledges funding from the Lee Kong Chian Fellowship, the Ministry of Education’s (MOE) Academic Research Fund (AcRF) (22-SOA-SMU-032), and MOE’s Tier 2 Research Grant (MOE-T2EP40124-0007). Zhang acknowledges funding from the Lee Kong Chian Professorship at Singapore Management University.

detail.abstract: We examine how labor market competition affects the quality of workplace information on social media. Using employer reviews on Glassdoor for U.S. publicly listed firms from 2011 to 2022, we find that reviews become less informative about actual workplace practices when firms face more intense competition for labor, consistent with competition inducing workplace information management. The decline in review informativeness is more pronounced when employees have narrower external networks, when firms are less unionized, and when firms have a smaller review base, suggesting that workplace information management is more likely when labor market information asymmetry is greater. Additional analyses show that positive reviews in highly competitive labor markets predict higher short-term labor inflows but greater subsequent employee turnover, indicating a systematic gap between managed expectations and actual workplace conditions. Taken together, our evidence suggests that labor market competition potentially distorts the crowdsourced signals available to job seekers on anonymous review platforms, highlighting an important source of information frictions in the labor market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了劳动力市场竞争如何影响社交媒体上职场信息的质量。通过分析Glassdoor上2011-2022年美国上市公司数据，发现当企业面临更激烈的劳动力竞争时，员工评论对实际工作环境的反映会变得不准确，表明企业存在信息管理行为。这种效应在员工外部网络狭窄、工会化程度低、评论基数小的企业中更显著。正面评论虽能短期吸引劳动力流入，但随后会导致更高的员工流失率，说明存在期望与实际之间的系统性差距。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场竞争如何影响社交媒体上职场信息（Glassdoor员工评论）的质量？
AI.motivation: 劳动力市场存在信息摩擦，求职者依赖匿名评论平台获取企业内部信息，而企业可能出于竞争压力有动机管理这些信息。已有研究关注产品市场竞争对信息披露的影响，但劳动力市场竞争对职场信息质量的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场竞争理论、信息不对称理论、信号理论、声誉管理理论
AI.method: 基于2011-2022年Glassdoor上美国上市公司的员工评论数据，采用实证分析方法，考察劳动力市场竞争强度与评论信息含量之间的关系，并进行异质性分析和后续效应检验。
AI.findings: 1）劳动力竞争越激烈，评论越不能准确反映实际工作环境；2）该效应在员工外部网络窄、工会化程度低、评论基数小的企业中更显著；3）高竞争市场中正面评论能短期吸引劳动力流入，但随后导致更高员工流失率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产品市场信息管理的研究视角扩展到劳动力市场，揭示了劳动力市场竞争作为信息摩擦的重要来源，拓展了对匿名评论平台信息质量影响因素的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为求职者提供警示：高竞争市场中正面评论可能被"管理"；为企业监管和平台治理提供参考，提示需要关注劳动力市场竞争对信息真实性的扭曲效应。

title: Sectoral Economic Efficiency and National Growth: A Novel Multi-Dimensional Framework with International Panel Evidence Across Development Stages

detail.title: Sectoral Economic Efficiency and National Growth: A Novel Multi-Dimensional Framework with International Panel Evidence Across Development Stages

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or affiliations that could have influenced the work reported in this study. No conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personally identifiable data requiring formal ethics committee approval. Where applicable, only publicly available or secondary data sources were used.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
